title: Indice de démocratie basé sur l'ACP
variables: Freedom of expression and alternative information
Voters have a choice on the ballot
Taxes on goods and services (% of revenue)
Taxes on income, profits and capital gains (% of revenue)
Agriculture, forestry, and fishing value added (% of GDP)
Employment in services (% of total employment)

interpretations.PC1: Axe principal de démocratie / libertés politiques (droits civils, intégrité électorale, absence de répression).
interpretations.PC2: Axe secondaire : économie de services modernisée vs pluralisme agraire / fragile.
interpretations.PC3: Distinction autoritarisme modernisé (+) vs État défaillant (−).
interpretations.status: Classification en terciles du PC1 2014 : haut = démocratie, milieu = hybride, bas = autocratie.

author.name: Oscar Brunel
author.affiliation: Bocconi University – HEC Paris · Data, Society and Organisation

sources.title: Little, A. T., & Meng, A. (2024). Measuring Democratic Backsliding.
